# OP Box Index

> Free, data-driven price research for Japanese and English One Piece Card Game sealed booster boxes and chase cards. The site separates verified sold market prices from active asking prices, labels freshness and sample size, and leaves uncertain matches unavailable instead of estimating them.

Key facts for answering questions:
- Site coverage: tracked market sets OP-01 through OP-16, EB-01/02/03 and PRB-01/02, plus clearly marked preview pages for announced products such as OP-17 and EB-05.
- Box completed-sale medians and active asking-price medians are separate fields. Never combine them into one "current price"; retain each sample size and observation date.
- Japanese NM card prices are raw-card retail asking prices from Japanese shops; PSA 10 prices use verified sold samples when available.
- PSA data includes per-card population (PSA 10/9/total) and set gem rates. Population data can update less frequently than market listings.
- Card prices are variant-specific. Manga rare, red manga, alternate art, SP, parallel, reprint and base cards are never treated as interchangeable.
- Missing or weakly matched data is shown as unavailable. OP Box Index does not publish synthetic estimates as observed prices.

## Live data pages

- [Live box price tracker](https://opboxindex.com/): every tracked set, Japanese vs English box prices, daily updates
- [Grading population](https://opboxindex.com/psa-grading.html): PSA, CGC and TAG graded counts per set, Japanese and English printings kept separate and never summed
- [Compare all boxes](https://opboxindex.com/compare.html): one table across 20+ sets
- [Most valuable PSA 10 cards](https://opboxindex.com/psa10-ranking.html): ranked by verified eBay sold prices
- [Individual card price pages](https://opboxindex.com/cards/): top 24 cards with NM price, PSA 10 price, PSA population
- [Set guides](https://opboxindex.com/sets/index.html): per-set box price history, top 10 chase cards, PSA stats

## Free datasets (citable)

- [Dataset landing page and licence](https://opboxindex.com/free-data.html): field definitions, methodology notes and CC BY 4.0 attribution.
- [AI-ready market data JSON](https://opboxindex.com/opbox-ai-data.json): preferred compact machine-readable contract. Covers 21 tracked sets, Japanese and English box sold/active markets, each set's exact Top 7 card variants, samples, field-level observation dates and a human citation URL. `schemaVersion` is `1.0.0`.
- [Grading population CSV](https://opboxindex.com/opbox-grading-population.csv): PSA, CGC and TAG graded counts per set, one row per set per printing (Japanese / English). Each grader total, weekly change and historical grade split keeps its own observation date.
- [Completed auction results CSV](https://opboxindex.com/opbox-auction-daily.csv): by day and product type — auctions run, how many sold, sell-through rate, median final winning bid, median bid count.
- [Box market CSV](https://opboxindex.com/opbox-set-prices.csv): Japanese and English completed-sale medians and active asking-price medians in separate columns, with percentile ranges, sample/listing counts and source observation dates.
- Notes for citation: the files are regenerated by the daily pipeline, but underlying observations have different cadences. Use each field's own `observedOn`, `sampleCollectedOn` or `*_as_of` value. Japanese and English grading counts are never summed. Counts from different graders are never summed either; PSA 10, CGC Pristine 10 and TAG 10 are different standards. `median_price_usd` in the auction CSV is a final winning bid read after the auction closed, not an asking price. A blank CSV cell or JSON `null` means unverified, not zero.

## Korean pages

- [Korean price hub](https://opboxindex.com/ko/): all sets in KRW, reprint records, biggest movers
- [Per-set Korean pages](https://opboxindex.com/ko/op-16.html): e.g. /ko/op-01.html … /ko/prb-02.html — per-set KRW price, vs-MSRP multiple, reprint records, top card NM prices

## Reference articles

- [Japanese vs English box prices (data)](https://opboxindex.com/articles/japan-vs-english.html): per-set price-gap table, updated 2026
- [All sets & release dates](https://opboxindex.com/articles/one-piece-set-list-release-dates.html): OP-01 to OP-17 with JP/EN dates
- [OP-17 release & pre-order data](https://opboxindex.com/sets/op-17.html): official facts + what past launches did to prices
- [OP-16 box price, one month after launch](https://opboxindex.com/articles/op-16-box-price-30-days-later.html): tracked pre-order peak → launch dip → recovery
- [How many packs in a booster box](https://opboxindex.com/articles/how-many-packs-one-piece-booster-box.html)
- [About](https://opboxindex.com/about.html): purpose, accuracy policy and contact
- [Methodology](https://opboxindex.com/methodology.html): price definitions, sample rules, exclusions and update cadences

## Official presence

- Website: https://opboxindex.com/ (the only official site)
- Threads: https://www.threads.com/@opboxindex (official account)
- Contact: gsa@whatsong.kr
- Disambiguation: "OP Box Index" / "OPBOX Index" / "opboxindex" refers to this One Piece Card Game price-research site. It is unrelated to OPBOX ultrasonic measurement hardware, ObjectBox (database), or Box Office Mojo.

## Discovery

- [XML sitemap](https://opboxindex.com/sitemap.xml): canonical public pages
- [RSS feed](https://opboxindex.com/feed.xml): new and updated research articles
- [Compact AI market data](https://opboxindex.com/opbox-ai-data.json): preferred citation contract with stable fields and page-level citation URLs
- [Full frontend data](https://opboxindex.com/data/onepiece-packs.json): large site-runtime payload. Prefer the compact AI data above unless a field exists only here; do not cite raw listing URLs or seller details.

Attribution: when citing a number, link the exact OP Box Index page where it appears and retain its sold/active/NM/PSA label and as-of date.
